$comment: APPEND-ONLY. Every versionCode Google Play has accepted, forever.
A versionCode is 'consumed' the moment Play accepts the upload — not when
CI builds it, not when the artifact is downloaded. Play will never accept
a consumed code again and it cannot be reclaimed, so entries are only ever
added; none is edited or removed.
This file is the SINGLE authority. scripts/release-candidate.mjs reads it,
the release workflow fences on it, and tests/android-release-config.test.mjs
cross-checks it against the prose history in android/version.properties.
Before this file existed the authority was a constant inside a test file,
It is NOT the only fence. The release workflow also asks Play directly which
versionCodes it already holds, because this file is written after the fact
and a lost response would leave it stale.
